title: Cech vanishing transfers along compatible covering-nerve comparisons
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with coefficients and covering index sets in the common universe [def-weil-size-convention], and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor. Let $\mathcal U=\{f_t:U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ be a covering and assume that $u(\mathcal U)=\{u(f_t):u(U_t)\to u(U)\}_{t\in T}$ is a covering. Choose tuple fibre products $W_{\mathbf t}$ in $\mathcal C$ and $P_{\mathbf t}$ in $\mathcal D$ and their omitting-factor projections as in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Suppose there are isomorphisms $c_{\mathbf t}:u(W_{\mathbf t})\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{\mathbf t}$ for every tuple of positive length such that, whenever $\delta_{W,j}:W_{\mathbf t}\to W_{\mathbf t\setminus t_j}$ and $\delta_{P,j}:P_{\mathbf t}\to P_{\mathbf t\setminus t_j}$ omit one factor of a tuple of length at least two, $$c_{\mathbf t\setminus t_j}\circ u(\delta_{W,j})=\delta_{P,j}\circ c_{\mathbf t}.$$ Let $F:\mathcal C^{op}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ and $G:\mathcal D^{op}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be abelian presheaves, and let $e:F\xrightarrow{\sim}G\circ u^{op}$ be a natural isomorphism of abelian presheaves. For every integer $p>0$, one has $$\check H^p(u(\mathcal U),G)=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\check H^p(\mathcal U,F)=0,$$ where both Cech cohomology groups are defined by the chosen alternating restriction complexes [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Neither presheaf is required to be a sheaf or injective; continuity and cocontinuity are not assumed beyond the displayed hypotheses.

proof.text: Write $A^n=\prod_{\mathbf t\in T^{n+1}}F(W_{\mathbf t})$ and $B^n=\prod_{\mathbf t\in T^{n+1}}G(P_{\mathbf t})$ for the degree-$n$ cochains of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Contravariance gives $G(c_{\mathbf t}^{-1}):G(uW_{\mathbf t})\to G(P_{\mathbf t})$. Define $a_{\mathbf t}=G(c_{\mathbf t}^{-1})\circ e_{W_{\mathbf t}}$ and $b_{\mathbf t}=e_{W_{\mathbf t}}^{-1}\circ G(c_{\mathbf t})$. Functoriality and the inverse identities for $c$ and $e$ give $a_{\mathbf t}b_{\mathbf t}=1$ and $b_{\mathbf t}a_{\mathbf t}=1$. Thus $(A_n s)_{\mathbf t}=a_{\mathbf t}(s_{\mathbf t})$ and $(B_n r)_{\mathbf t}=b_{\mathbf t}(r_{\mathbf t})$ are mutually inverse group homomorphisms $A^n\rightleftarrows B^n$ for every $n\ge0$. In negative degrees use the unique maps between zero groups.

source.place: Tag 0D6X, lemma-pullback-injective-pre-limp, proof, displayed Cech comparison; explicit componentwise comparison argument.

proof.text: For a tuple $\mathbf t$ of length at least two, put $\mathbf s=\mathbf t\setminus t_j$. The assumed face square gives $u(\delta_{W,j})\circ c_{\mathbf t}^{-1}=c_{\mathbf s}^{-1}\circ\delta_{P,j}$. Applying the contravariant functor $G$ yields $G(c_{\mathbf t}^{-1})G(u(\delta_{W,j}))=G(\delta_{P,j})G(c_{\mathbf s}^{-1})$. Naturality of $e$ says $e_{W_{\mathbf t}}F(\delta_{W,j})=G(u(\delta_{W,j}))e_{W_{\mathbf s}}$. Combining these two equalities gives $a_{\mathbf t}F(\delta_{W,j})=G(\delta_{P,j})a_{\mathbf s}$. Sum this equality with the signs $(-1)^j$ in the differential formula of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], using additivity of each $a_{\mathbf t}$. Hence $A_{n+1}d_A^n=d_B^nA_n$ for $n\ge0$. Multiplying by the inverse degree maps gives $d_A^nB_n=B_{n+1}d_B^n$.

source.place: Tag 0D6X, lemma-pullback-injective-pre-limp, proof, displayed Cech comparison; explicit componentwise comparison argument.

proof.text: Fix $p>0$ and suppose $\check H^p(u(\mathcal U),G)=0$. By the kernel/image definition in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], every $d_B$-cocycle of degree $p$ is $d_B^{p-1}r$ for some $r\in B^{p-1}$: its class in $\ker d_B^p/\operatorname{im}d_B^{p-1}$ is zero. For any $z\in A^p$ with $d_A^pz=0$, Step 2 gives $d_B^pA_pz=0$, so choose $r$ with $d_B^{p-1}r=A_pz$. Then $d_A^{p-1}(B_{p-1}r)=B_pd_B^{p-1}r=B_pA_pz=z$. Every $A$-cocycle is therefore a boundary, and the same quotient definition gives $\check H^p(\mathcal U,F)=0$. Here $p-1\ge0$; only the stipulated face compatibility, coefficient naturality, and group operations were used.

lean.statement: theorem isZero_cohomology_of_coverNerve {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D] (J : Precoverage C) (K : Precoverage D) (_hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings) (_hK : K.IsSiteForCoverings) (u : C ⥤ D) {T : Type u} {U : C} (f : T → C) (hom : ∀ t, f t ⟶ U) (_hcover : Presieve.ofArrows f hom ∈ J U) (_himage : Presieve.ofArrows (fun t ↦ u.obj (f t)) (fun t ↦ u.map (hom t)) ∈ K (u.obj U)) (W : SiteCechComplex f hom) (P : SiteCechComplex (fun t ↦ u.obj (f t)) (fun t ↦ u.map (hom t))) (c : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → T), u.obj (W.W n t) ≅ P.W n t) (_hc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 2) → T) (j : Fin (n + 2)), u.map (W.indexMap t j.succAbove) ≫ (c n (t ∘ j.succAbove)).hom = (c (n + 1) t).hom ≫ P.indexMap t j.succAbove) (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (G : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (_e : F ≅ u.op ⋙ G) (p : ℕ) (_hp : 0 < p) : IsZero ((P.cohomologyFunctor p).obj G) → IsZero ((W.cohomologyFunctor p).obj F)

No added sheaf, injectivity, continuity or limit-preservation assumption. Checked against Stacks 0D6X proof; argument re-derived, true.
